units.source_text: 她常常想：“我决心赴死之时，觉得可恋之人甚多。

en.t: She often thought, "When I had resolved to die, I felt there were so many people dear to me.

units.source_text: 但现在并不十分想念其他的人，只是记挂母亲，不知她何等悲伤！

en.t: But now I do not miss the others very much; I only worry about my mother, wondering how deeply she must be grieving!

units.source_text: 还有乳母，她一心希望我同别人一样荣华富贵，自我失踪以后，不知她何等失望，又不知她现在何处。

en.t: And my nurse, who wholeheartedly hoped that I would enjoy honor and prosperity like everyone else; since I disappeared, how disappointed she must have been, and I do not know where she is now.

units.source_text: 她们怎么会知道我还活在世间呢？

en.t: How could they possibly know that I am still alive in this world?

units.source_text: 我现在一个知心的人也没有。

en.t: Now I do not have even one person who truly understands my heart.

units.source_text: 从前时刻不离、无话不谈的右近等人，不知又如何了。”

en.t: I wonder what has become of Ukon and the others, who once were never away from me and with whom I could speak about anything."
